ctx.x: I see, because I knew Leon Heflin's name from the Cavalcade of Jazz.

Yeah, well, then, Leon Heflin used to have a big furniture factory here. He was pretty smart boy. He had a great big furniture factory, then after his furniture factory kinda failed, he went into the coffin business--building coffins, and then after that, he ...let's see, what else...then he went into the...uh, promoting jazz. He had all the big bands that come through here. He would have, like, if Duke would come through, and if he had two, three days, he would give him a shot over at the ballpark or somewhere.…
So...and the ballpark was Wrigley Field, right?
